members.name: relative_momentum_v1
members.thesis: Stocks showing intraday return > 2x NIFTY 50 intraday return (when NIFTY is up) exhibit persistent relative momentum for the remainder of the session. This occurs because institutional allocation decisions (mutual funds, FIIs) that drive one stock to outperform unfold over hours, not minutes. If HDF
members.exit_target: 0.5% absolute return on the stock (not relative)
members.exit_stop: 0.3% from entry OR relative_return flips sign (stock now underperforming)
filters: no specific filter — relative momentum is market-condition-agnostic
no entries before 10:30 (need morning to establish RS) or after 14:30

members.name: relative_strength_momentum_v1
members.thesis: Stocks showing the strongest intraday returns relative to their sector peers in the first 60 minutes tend to continue outperforming for the next 2-3 hours. This is driven by information asymmetry — when one stock in a sector moves first, institutional flow follows into that specific name. The leader
members.exit_target: 0.5% from entry for longs; -0.5% for shorts
filters: compute rankings at 10:15; enter at 10:30; exit by 14:30
stock must have > ₹10Cr turnover in first hour
for longs: nifty50 return from open > -0.3% (not a crash day)
weaknesses: First-hour leaders can be driven by one-off news that doesn't persist — mean reversion takes over

members.name: vwap_relative_strength_v1
members.thesis: Comparing a stock's deviation from its VWAP to NIFTY 50's deviation from its VWAP reveals relative strength/weakness. members.exit_target: 0.6% from entry (ride the relative strength wave)
members.exit_stop: 0.3% from entry OR relative_vwap_strength crosses zero (lost relative edge)
filters: no specific VIX filter — relative strength works across regimes
no entries before 10:00 (need 45 bars of data) or after 14:30
prefer longs on days where NIFTY is range-bound (not >1% trend), as relative strength is more meaningful
weaknesses: Requires real-time NIFTY 50 VWAP computation alongside stock VWAP — double the data infrastructure
Relative strength can flip quickly if sector rotation occurs mid-day (e.g., IT to banks)
In strong market trend days (>1.5% NIFTY move), all stocks move together and relative strength signals are noise
